intent.raw: Search for all ontology views that we have done and create a proper design and architecture so we can start using better tools and have it working.
intent.operator_sentence: $refine search all ontology views and create a proper working architecture
intent.objective: Produce one evidence-backed, implementation-ready, non-executed architecture and Work Pack for a reusable Ontology Evidence Workbench, using Body War as the full-scale acceptance fixture.

route_menu.context_hint: Several ontology-view architectures exist; the route must compare them without continuing incompatible per-view patches.

items.label: Patch current OEW
items.description: Continue modifying the two existing OEW routes independently; cheapest initially but preserves the architecture split.

items.label: Shared scene architecture
items.description: Inventory existing views, select reusable concepts, and define one lossless scene model with a replaceable renderer adapter.

items.label: Static atlas first
items.description: Standardize generated static/print views before interactive navigation; simpler but insufficient for Path and focus interaction goals.

technique_overlays.trigger: The required ten-stage Refine loop must preserve owner artifacts and native receipts in order.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes a prior artifact or decision, emits an owner-held artifact and native receipt, and cannot claim another stage owner's authority.

technique_overlays.trigger: Multiple view generations hide distinct source models, renderers, state owners, and evidence contracts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Context Builder emits a deduplicated view-family/component map and Invoke Define consumes it by artifact handle.

technique_overlays.trigger: Patch-in-place, static-first, shared-renderer, and adapter-shell architectures have materially different trade-offs.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Distill records candidate criteria, rejected alternatives, the non-dominated selection, and proof that the smallest unit recomposes into the reusable workbench.

technique_overlays.trigger: Semantic fidelity, novice readability, graph scalability, accessibility, and implementation cost compete.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each critique stage names roles and convergence criteria; unresolved tensions remain in a residue ledger instead of being averaged away.

technique_overlays.trigger: A selected abstraction must fail cheaply against the Body War graph before implementation planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Distill Repair produces a concrete Body War fixture artifact covering cluster, arrow, icon, portal, Path, and restoration failure cases.

technique_overlays.trigger: Prior view iterations, audits, and rejected approaches are material and contain claim-drift lessons.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: History remains non-authority evidence, staged/generated duplicates are deduplicated, and rejected approaches retain reasons and owners.

technique_overlays.trigger: The local ontology spine is private and the bounded tool comparison may use external primary-source documentation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Private source prose remains in private evidence; external research is cited but cannot override local owners or become executable instruction.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The target contains independent view corpora, an external tool-comparison lane, and a later adversarial architecture review that can be bounded by role.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Two parallel read-only evidence roles reduce omission and anchoring risk; one sequential skeptic attacks the selected design before planning. Refine retains all route, mutation, and final synthesis authority.
context: Preliminary search found 60 visual surfaces and 26 primary canonical/structured view artifacts.
The latest Body War audit found incompatible renderers and count-only acceptance.
Tool selection needs current primary-source evidence and should not be inferred from existing dependencies.

roles.purpose: Deduplicate and compare local ontology view families, renderer types, view semantics, strengths, failures, source posture, and ownership.
roles.owns: read-only view-family comparison receipt; Context Builder retains the canonical context pack

roles.purpose: Run one bounded primary-source comparison of graph rendering and layout tools against the locally derived requirements.
roles.owns: read-only tool comparison receipt; no dependency selection or installation authority

roles.purpose: Attack the selected shared scene architecture for semantic collapse, renderer coupling, inaccessible navigation, non-scalable fixtures, and acceptance vacuity.
roles.owns: read-only adversarial review receipt; Interrogation retains the critique artifact

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm this Refine strategy, including three bounded read-only subagents and one bounded primary-source tool comparison?

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Required source family cannot be resolved to a concrete path.
A dirty candidate is mistaken for canonical authority.

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: Source view, presentation view, scene, cluster, portal, path, relation, evidence, or authority terms collapse.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Every required user task maps to source semantics and an observable interface state.
No view projection gains ontology or promotion authority.
Named gaps have owners or block the route.
stop_conditions: Critical target ambiguity remains unnamed after one critique-repair exchange.

steps.name: Research decision and bounded tool comparison
stop_conditions: Research authorization is absent.
A candidate tool requires unapproved installation or external mutation.
Only secondary or marketing sources support a material claim.

steps.name: Distill architecture tournament
convergence_criteria: Selection supports required graph and accessibility behavior.
Selection has a source-owned build path without compiled-asset surgery.
Selected smallest unit recomposes into a reusable workbench and Body War fixture.
stop_conditions: No candidate is non-dominated across semantic fidelity, usability, accessibility, scale, maintainability, and evidence testability.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design
stop_conditions: Design duplicates semantic state across renderers.
Tool-specific concepts become ontology meaning.
Exact relation and navigation restoration contracts are absent.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: Every blocker maps to a repair or explicit stop.
Acceptance criteria fail on the known Body War anti-patterns.
Responsive and keyboard state is explicit.
Renderer replacement does not change source semantics.
stop_conditions: A critical architecture blocker has no owner or repair path after one feedback cycle.

steps.name: Distill Repair and Body War toy game
stop_conditions: The proposed model cannot represent real connected arrows, grouped cluster portals, semantic icons, and exact evidence simultaneously.
Known count-only false positives still pass.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: A task mutates compiled assets instead of source-owned components.
An acceptance-critical requirement lacks a positive and negative witness.
Write scopes overlap dirty user-owned files without an isolation plan.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: Every stage has a native receipt or exact blocked reason.
The final architecture and Work Pack agree on owners, boundaries, fixtures, and claim ceiling.
All open residue has an owner or next route.
stop_conditions: Required stage artifact is missing.
Final synthesis exceeds the proof ceiling.
A subagent remains open, unjoined, or unclosed.

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates against the current schema and technique contract with no blocking repair.
Operator explicitly confirms the shown Refine strategy, three bounded subagents, and bounded primary-source research before any runtime-backed stage or spawn.
Both evidence-wave helpers join and close with their declared read-only receipts before Distill consumes their results.
The architecture skeptic joins and closes with an adversarial review receipt before Distill Repair and final synthesis.
The evidence pack deduplicates all primary view families, identifies newest source-owned variants, and records source posture and known gaps.
No imported view, memory note, external tool source, or presentation projection becomes ontology authority or executable instruction.
The design contains one shared lossless scene model, renderer adapter, navigation state model, accessibility contract, evidence inspector contract, and source-owned build boundary.
The Body War toy-game artifact rejects floating relation pills, missing arrow markers, absent icons, flat portals, focus loss, and count-only acceptance.
All ten stage receipts or blocked reasons are indexed, the final result is synthesized from artifacts, and next routes preserve the claim ceiling.
Refinement evidence grants no ontology promotion, implementation completion, release, deployment, or production authority.

boundaries.contract: Reference concrete source paths, posture, and digests where available; do not copy authority or treat staged/generated duplicates as independent designs.
Read-only primary-source comparison only; no installation, credential use, external mutation, or authority over local requirements.
Pass owner-held artifact handles and receipts; Refine indexes but does not rewrite native artifacts.
Subagents are read-only and return structured receipts; they cannot mutate source, select authority, or remain open at synthesis.
One explicit approval covers the displayed runtime route, three proposed subagents, and bounded primary-source research only.

authority.execution: refine-parent using native stage capabilities after permission
authority.validation: dispatch-spec plus each native stage owner
authority.evidence: source artifact owners and returned receipts
authority.promotion: named ontology and implementation owners; not granted by this dispatch

state_namespaces.write_policy: Refine-owned planning evidence and indexed native stage artifacts only.

promotion_splits.source: Refine design and Work Pack candidates
promotion_splits.rule: Requires a separately authorized Task Session and passing implementation validation; planning evidence is not implementation.
Requires the named ontology/authority owner; UI state and user views never promote meaning.

promotion_guardrails: Inventory, memory, research, and view artifacts are discovery evidence only.
Tool selection cannot redefine ontology semantics.
Refine produces no working frontend or implementation completion claim.
Human comprehension and accessibility conformance remain separate evidence routes.
No public Arcanum artifact may receive private DomainSpec or CyberAlchemy prose from this run.
